name: DokuWiki
description: DokuWiki is a simple to use and highly versatile wiki that needs no database: pages are stored as plain text files that stay readable outside the wiki. It brings revision history, access control lists, a media manager and full-text search, and over a thousand community plugins and templates extend it.

notes.text: Log in with the admin user and the generated password from /opt/dokuwiki_data/.env inside the container.
Everyone can read the wiki, only logged-in users can edit and upload. Self-registration is off: add accounts under Admin > User Manager, change the policy under Admin > Access Control List.
